the higher plant pigment complement is a compromise between the need to absorb light for photosynthesis and the need to protect against photodamage.
the green color of higher plants evolved from the need to protect chlorophylls from photodamage, and not to absorb light.

green light is a very important part of photosynthetic light absorption, and it is a very useful part of the spectrum to be utilized for photosynthesis.
the green color of higher plants is not an accident, but rather the result of an evolutionary adaptation.
